scope.evaluation: fixture train rows for search; frozen held-out rows for correctness
scope.selection: weights tuned only on shadow tasks
scope.shadow_eval: seen-task held-out evaluation; shadow train rows are used for fitting and selection
scope.paired: same seeds, tasks, and path-specific budgets
scope.work_cost: signature_evaluations are reported as canonical work and may be ranker-invariant

provenance.source_hash_scope: repository rsi_programmer Python files, measurement script, imported SpikeForge Python source bytes and fixture bytes
